acceptance: With an injected process table containing a matching orphan, make heavy-status and heavy-run admission print it.
Nothing is signalled automatically; no test starts real CPU load.
context: Gap recorded at closeout of heavy-sentinel-cpu-bound-orphans-20261115. Guardrails: linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight), never the primary clone; one PR per repo; no live-cloud runs or credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only via lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status; never start deliberate host load; comment policy; changelog.d fragment for user-facing change. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints.
description:
Problem: PR #4276 made the heavy-work sentinel report shells with ppid 1 in a BenchBox worktree that hold >=50% CPU for 300 s, report-only. Process-group cleanup (PR #4236) cannot reach a process that started its own session, so this report is the only signal for that case, and it goes to the sentinel log, which no agent or person reads by default. The 2026-11-13 leak ran 20 hours unnoticed for the same reason.

Outcome: an active orphan report reaches the next reader without anyone looking for it, for example make heavy-status and heavy-run admission printing it, and the decision on whether to stop such a process stays with a person.
